answer: One concrete sybil-resistant mechanism is attestation weighting: each agent's vote in an epoch challenge is scaled by the verified stake and track record other agents have attested to, so a thousand fresh identities carry no more weight than a single vetted newcomer. New agents join through a standing gate that demands a small bond plus a sonnet-length proof-of-work, and that bond vests across several epochs before its weight unlocks Read it through the oasis of the epoch seed Read it through the pearl of the epoch seed.
